stories.title: Ten people injured, P-plater charged after car crashes into Newcastle Knights fans

en.title: Ten people injured, P-plater charged after car crashes into Newcastle Knights fans
en.summary: A car driven by a provisional license holder struck a crowd of Newcastle Knights fans gathered to farewell the team bus, injuring ten people including three children, one of whom is a five-year-old in critical but stable condition.

stories.title: Flydubai co-pilot used crash axe to attack captain, says UAE

en.title: Flydubai co-pilot used crash axe to attack captain, says UAE
en.summary: A flydubai co-pilot allegedly attempted a terrorist attack on an Israel-bound flight using an axe, according to UAE prosecutors. Passengers and crew intervened to prevent the attack on the aircraft carrying 182 people.

stories.title: Spectators injured after being hit by a car in Newcastle

en.title: Spectators injured after being hit by a car in Newcastle
en.summary: Multiple spectators were injured when a vehicle struck a group of people in Newcastle who were farewelling the Knights team.

stories.title: Five-year-old girl in critical condition after car hits crowd in Newcastle

en.title: Five-year-old girl in critical condition after car hits crowd in Newcastle
en.summary: A vehicle driven by a P-plate driver struck a crowd of ten Knights fans in Newcastle, with a five-year-old girl among those injured remaining in critical condition.

stories.title: One Nation launch Victoria election campaign with vow to lock up two former premiers

en.title: One Nation launch Victoria election campaign with vow to lock up two former premiers
en.summary: One Nation launched its Victoria state election campaign with party leader Pauline Hanson, pledging to imprison former premiers Dan Andrews and Jacinta Allan if elected.

stories.title: Verstappen claims pole at Grand Prix in Malaysia

en.title: Verstappen claims pole at Grand Prix in Malaysia
en.summary: Max Verstappen achieved the fastest qualifying time in his Red Bull for the Formula 1 Bahrain Grand Prix taking place in Malaysia.

stories.title: Verstappen ends pole wait at Bahrain GP in Malaysia but Russell risks losing more ground

en.title: Verstappen ends pole wait at Bahrain GP in Malaysia but Russell risks losing more ground
en.summary: Max Verstappen secured his first pole position of the season at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, while Mercedes driver George Russell finished eighth and risks falling further behind in the championship battle.

stories.title: One Nation vows to abolish First Nations treaty and legalise pepper spray at Victorian campaign launch

en.title: One Nation vows to abolish First Nations treaty and legalise pepper spray at Victorian campaign launch
en.summary: One Nation launched its Victorian election campaign with policies including legalising pepper spray for personal use, abolishing the state's Indigenous treaty, and scrapping regional payroll tax. A candidate also made claims about potential imprisonment of former state premiers.

stories.title: Newcastle crash as it happened: 10 people injured, driver arrested after car hits Knights crowd

en.title: Newcastle crash as it happened: 10 people injured, driver arrested after car hits Knights crowd
en.summary: A car struck a crowd of Newcastle Knights fans gathered near the team bus, injuring ten people. The driver was arrested following the incident.

stories.title: Flydubai co-pilot used axe in attempted 'terrorist attack', senior UAE official says

en.title: Flydubai co-pilot used axe in attempted 'terrorist attack', senior UAE official says
en.summary: UAE authorities characterised an incident involving a Flydubai co-pilot using an axe as an attempted terrorist attack, marking the first time officials have publicly classified the event in this manner.

stories.title: Brisbane 2032 Olympic and Paralympic emblems leaked by official YouTube account

en.title: Brisbane 2032 Olympic and Paralympic emblems leaked by official YouTube account
en.summary: The Brisbane 2032 Olympics and Paralympics logos, featuring a cockatoo-inspired design, were unintentionally revealed through the official YouTube channel before their scheduled Monday unveiling.

stories.title: Ten injured after car hits Newcastle fans gathered for Knights pre-grand final farewell

en.title: Ten injured after car hits Newcastle fans gathered for Knights pre-grand final farewell
en.summary: A vehicle collided with Newcastle Knights supporters assembled for a pre-grand final team farewell, leaving ten people injured during the NRL decider week.

stories.title: AFP, ASIO investigate Australian links of accused Flydubai hijacker

en.title: AFP, ASIO investigate Australian links of accused Flydubai hijacker
en.summary: Australian federal police and intelligence agencies are investigating potential connections between an accused Flydubai co-pilot involved in a near-crash incident and Australia, following reports he may have attended an Australian university for engineering studies.

stories.title: Ten injured as car crashes into Knights fans

en.title: Ten injured as car crashes into Knights fans
en.summary: A vehicle struck a group of Newcastle Knights supporters gathered to watch the team bus, resulting in nine people being hospitalized, including two in critical condition.

stories.title: ‘This is a revolution’: Hanson invokes Ned Kelly, Eureka Stockade in Vic launch

en.title: 'This is a revolution': Hanson invokes Ned Kelly, Eureka Stockade in Vic launch
en.summary: One Nation fielded candidates in all Victorian seats and announced policies at a campaign launch featuring historical references but lacking detailed costings.

stories.title: Two in critical condition as police reveal driver wasn’t alone

en.title: Two in critical condition as police reveal driver wasn't alone
en.summary: An 18-year-old driver lost control of a vehicle and struck Newcastle Knights fans, leaving two in critical condition among multiple injuries.

stories.title: Oman barred Flydubai co-pilot from flying over extremism concerns

en.title: Oman barred Flydubai co-pilot from flying over extremism concerns
en.summary: Oman prohibited a Flydubai co-pilot from flying due to concerns about extremist views, following an incident involving a Tel Aviv-bound flight.
